messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **Canadian federal holidays** that create “long weekends” (i.e., a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day weekend).  
*(Note: Some holidays are province‑specific – see the footnotes for details.)*

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Weekend Days Covered | Province‑Specific Notes |
|-------------|---------|----------------------|------------------------|
| **Jan 1**   | New Year’s Day | Fri 1 – Sun 3 | Federal |
| **Feb 20**  | Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK, NB, PE) | Mon 18 – Wed 20 | BC, AB, ON, SK, NB, PE |
| **Apr 7**   | Good Friday | Fri 7 – Sun 9 | Federal |
| **May 22**  | Victoria Day | Mon 20 – Wed 22 | Federal |
| **Jul 1**   | Canada Day | Fri 1 – Sun 3 | Federal |
| **Sep 4**   | Labour Day | Mon 2 – Wed 4 | Federal |
| **Oct 9**   | Thanksgiving | Mon 7 – Wed 9 | Federal |
| **Nov 10**  | Remembrance Day (observed) | Fri 10 – Sun 12 | Federal (observed on Monday if on Sunday) |
| **Dec 25**  | Christmas Day | Fri 25 – Sun 27 | Federal |
| **Dec 26**  | Boxing Day | Mon 26 – Wed 28 | Federal |

### Quick Summary (by month)

| Month | Long Weekend Dates | Holiday |
|-------|--------------------|---------|
| January | Jan 1–3 | New Year’s Day |
| February | Feb 18–20 | Family Day (in participating provinces) |
| April | Apr 7–9 | Good Friday |
| May | May 20–22 | Victoria Day |
| July | Jul 1–3 | Canada Day |
| September | Sep 2–4 | Labour Day |
| October | Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving |
| November | Nov 10–12 | Remembrance Day (observed) |
| December | Dec 23–25 | Christmas Day |
| December | Dec 26–28 | Boxing Day |

> **Tip for App Integration**  
> If you’re building a holiday‑planning feature, consider storing each holiday as an object with fields such as `name`, `date`, `province` (if applicable), and `isLongWeekend`. This will let you filter by province or by whether the holiday creates a long weekend.

Let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need province‑specific holiday lists!
